info.name: V52 Tier3 Team 34 API
info.description:
Complete collection for testing the V52 Tier3 Team 34 REST API endpoints. This is the main collection that references all modular collections.

## Authentication
- Uses Google OAuth 2.0 for secure authentication
- JWT (JSON Web Tokens) are required for most endpoints
- Obtain tokens via `/auth/login` endpoint
- Token must be included in Authorization header as 'Bearer {token}'
- Tokens have a limited lifespan and will need periodic refresh
